title: Normalized tensor comparison for completed constant realization
statement: Let X be a scheme, A a commutative ring and d an adic coefficient datum. Let Q be completed constant extension followed by intrinsic-presentation restriction and the canonical small-site equivalence [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion, def-weil-pbc-completed-cech-site-transport], H its termwise action on complexes, O the actual completed ring on the small site, and c the composite of the two specified regular coefficient units. For arbitrary cochain complexes K,L of A-modules there are isomorphisms t(K,L):H(Tot(K tensor L)) to Tot(H(K) tensor H(L)), using the existing total tensor [def-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-system]. They are natural in both chain maps. For arbitrary module maps v:A to K^0 and w:A to L^0, c followed by Q of the inverse right unitor, v tensor w and total inclusion of summand (0,0), and then t(K,L)^0 equals the inverse left unitor of O followed by (c composed with Q(v)) tensor (c composed with Q(w)), then the target total inclusion of summand (0,0). No Koszul complex, transition, or exterior power occurs in this assertion.

source.place: Tags 03D8, 03EK and 0GMW: composition of pullback, change of rings and sheafification with tensor products; apply the displayed tensor formulas to each total-complex summand.

proof.text: Prove preservation of countable coproducts for the constant module presheaf by joint reflection at evaluations. Module sheafification preserves colimits as a left adjoint. The named ordinary scalar adjunction shows that completed constant extension preserves colimits. Inverse restriction along the completed coefficient isomorphism and the site functor are equivalences and also preserve them.

Take the normalized ordinary tensor isomorphism for completed constant modules. Compose its image under the coefficient/site functor with the existing normalized module tensor transport. Naturality follows in each module variable. The right-unitor normalization for the latter functor gives its regular-module tensor normalization, using right-unitor naturality and equality of the two unitors at the unit. Tensor naturality then combines this equation with the constant-module regular equation.

Apply the existing HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorComparison to this composed ordinary tensor isomorphism. The coproduct preservation proved above makes the comparison invertible. The comparison naturality and the equality between the combined bifunctor map and its successive maps give naturality in both complexes.

The summand formula for mapBifunctorComparison at (0,0) reduces the displayed normalization to naturality of the ordinary comparison in v and w. Its regular-module equation proved in step 2 and tensor functoriality give exactly the requested composite, with the specified coefficient map and inverse left unitor.

theorem completedRealizationTensor
    (X : Scheme.{u}) {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) :
    let F := intrinsicPresentationModulesBack X d ⋙ (completedCechModulesEquiv X d).functor
    let G := completedKoszulConstant X (intrinsicPresentationDatum d)
    let Q := G ⋙ F
    let H := Q.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let O := completedCechRing X d
    let c := completedCechCoefficientUnit X d ≫
      F.map (completedKoszulOne X (intrinsicPresentationDatum d))
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory O
    letI := SheafOfModules.symmetricCategory O
    letI := Classical.choice (SheafOfModules.tensorClosed O).1
    letI := Classical.choice (SheafOfModules.tensorClosed O).2.1
    ∃ t : ∀ K L : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) ℤ,
        H.obj (HomologicalComplex.tensorObj K L) ≅
          ((ringedKoszulTensor O).obj (H.obj K)).obj (H.obj L),
      (∀ (K L K' L' : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) ℤ)
          (f : K ⟶ K') (g : L ⟶ L'),
        H.map (HomologicalComplex.tensorHom f g) ≫ (t K' L').hom =
          (t K L).hom ≫ ((ringedKoszulTensor O).map (H.map f)).app (H.obj L) ≫
            ((ringedKoszulTensor O).obj (H.obj K')).map (H.map g)) ∧
      (∀ (K L : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) ℤ)
          (v : ModuleCat.of A A ⟶ K.X 0) (w : ModuleCat.of A A ⟶ L.X 0),
        c ≫ Q.map ((ρ_ (ModuleCat.of A A)).inv ≫ (v ⊗ₘ w) ≫
          HomologicalComplex.ιTensorObj K L 0 0 0 (by omega)) ≫ (t K L).hom.f 0 =
        (λ_ (SheafOfModules.unit ((sheafCompose (completedCechTopology X)
          (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj O))).inv ≫
          ((c ≫ Q.map v) ⊗ₘ (c ≫ Q.map w)) ≫
            CochainComplex.ιMapBifunctor (H.obj K) (H.obj L)
              (curriedTensor _) 0 0 0 (by omega))
